Source: Storm's two hours out. You here to help or to drip on my floor?
I'll help. What do you need?
Where do I pour it again?
The light's on. Can I go up?
My lamp's dark and it drinks oil. Last can went missing off the pier this morning.
My brother kept a spare in the net crates. Pip might know which one.
Up the stairs, pour it in, strike the lever. Don't touch the lens.
Go on, then. Mind the third step. It bites.
Are you the ferry person? Nobody comes on the ferry! Well, three people. Today it's you!
Oil? The blue net crate! Mara's brother hid stuff there. I'm not supposed to know that.
You found it before me? I've lived here a hundred years!
